text:
incident-bot: [P1] billing-metering-delay — multiple emitter shards reporting >15m emit delay, surge of backfilled events observed. Auto-paging oncall-metering.
Alex: ack, I'm on it. Triageing now — checking kafka consumer lag & emitter pod health.
Sara: seeing a late dump from emitter-3 -> consumer lag jumped then a big commit. overage_flags spiked in the aggregator around 02:14 UTC.
Mike: I can try a rolling restart of emitter-3 if needed. any hints from logs?
Alex: running quick check:
```sh
# kubectl -n metering logs deploy/emitter-3 --tail=80 | grep -i commit
2026-03-15T02:10:21Z WARN commit failed: Timeout
2026-03-15T02:10:22Z INFO consumer rebalanced, backlog=12487
2026-03-15T02:13:58Z INFO processed batch size=12000, emit_delay=00:15:36
```
Alex: looks like consumer group stalled then processed a big backlog -> explains delayed emits and large token deltas.
Sara: that big batch pushed hundreds of customers into "overage flag" state in the billing layer. Not all flags equate to charged usage yet — we're still pre-invoice.
Mike: restarting emitter consumer now (rolling) and scaling replicas to 4 to catch up faster. Doing it in EU region first.
Alex: approved. Mike: please monitor commit lag and tail aggregator logs.
Mike: done. replicas -> 4, restart kicked. Watching lag metric -> dropping from 12k -> 3k in last 2m.
Sara: muting automated overage alerting in console to prevent customer emails. billing-console-bot please mute route: /alerts/overage-spikes-eu
billing-console-bot: Confirmed -> alerting route /alerts/overage-spikes-eu muted by Sara for 60m.
Lina: CS here — we have 2 customers (ACME & BetaSoft) with support tickets noting unexpected overage emails. ACME asking if they're being charged. No invoices generated yet.
Alex: Customer impact summary: probable false-visible overage flags for ~40-80 accounts in EU, no charges applied yet because billing window is pending. Recommend: hold invoice run for affected window and run targeted reconciliation once backfill completes.
Sara: starting a focused recon job: reconcile-token-deltas --window=02:00-03:00 --filter=region:eu; will report delta counts in 15m.
Mike: metric check: token-emit-rate normalized; lag now under 500. Backfills still streaming but steady.
Alex: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-late-emit - follow section "suppress alerts & hold billing". Adding note: do not auto-apply credits until manual reconciliation.
Lina: prepping customer comms template. Holding off until we have recon numbers. Will notify affected customers that we're investigating and invoices are paused.
Sara: recon job initial output (snippet):
```text
reconciled_customers=54
total_token_delta=+184k
suspect_overage_flags=58
```
Sara: plan: (1) finalize recon, (2) reverse any automatic flag transitions for these 58 accounts, (3) run invoice hold for that billing window, (4) follow up with CS for targeted comms.
Alex: handoff plan — I'm paging oncall-metering-night (Maria) for overnight watch and backfill verification. Leaving a checklist in the thread: - verify kafka lag <1k - confirm recon finished and deltas applied - unmute alerts only after manual signoff - create postmortem draft with root cause and timeline.
Maria: acked. I'll pick this up at 03:00 UTC and run the backfill validation. Will post a short status at 03:15 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Mike: logging action items in incident tracker: INC-2026-0423. I'll attach metrics and restart timestamps.
Alex: thanks. I'll stay until handoff complete. If recon shows sustained discrepancies, we may need a coordinated ledger backfill and customer credit batch.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=monitoring, severity=P1 -> P2 candidate if no regression within 30m. Handoff scheduled to Maria at 03:00 UTC.
Maria: will report back after validation. leaving contact: @Maria (oncall-metering-night).
